mapper.select: SELECT c.code_grp_id AS "groupId",c.code,c.code_nm AS name, (c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' AND length(c.code)<=10) AS active,m.src_text AS source FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code_map m ON m.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id AND m.code=c.code WHERE c.code_grp_id IN ('EMP_TYPE','GRADE','JOB','JBPS','DRCT_CLS') ORDER BY c.code_grp_id,c.code,m.map_id
SELECT mng_no AS "managementNo",dev_nm AS name,jncmp_dt AS "hireDate" FROM tb_hr_dev
SELECT clnt_id AS id,clnt_nm AS name,biz_reg_no AS "businessNo" FROM tb_bs_clnt WHERE use_yn='Y' AND clnt_type_cd IN ('VNDR','BOTH')
SELECT part_id AS id,part_nm AS name,(hq_yn='Y') AS headquarters FROM tb_bs_part WHERE use_yn='Y'
SELECT area_cd AS code,area_lvl_cd AS level,upper_area_cd AS "parentCode",sido_nm AS sido,sido_full_nm AS "fullName",sgg_nm AS sgg,emd_nm AS emd FROM tb_sy_adm_area WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY area_cd
SELECT DISTINCT h.hdong_nm AS name,h.area_cd AS "areaCode" FROM tb_sy_adm_hdong h JOIN tb_sy_adm_area a ON a.area_cd=h.area_cd WHERE a.use_yn='Y'
SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value+1 ELSE last_value END FROM sq_tb_hr_dev_mng_no

SELECT upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS filename,file_size AS size, reg_user_id AS actor,upld_stat_cd AS status,tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows",aply_dttm AS "appliedAt" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT rslt_sn AS sequence,rslt_type_cd AS severity,row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS reason FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY row_no,rslt_sn

SELECT d.dev_id AS id,d.mng_no AS "managementNo" FROM tb_sy_chg_hist h JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=h.trgt_key WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm='TB_HR_DEV' AND h.chg_type_cd='NEW' AND h.chg_rsn=#{reason} ORDER BY h.hist_id
